errors.evidence: The blue line (Abfluss) in 2005 is approximately 100.000 Mrd. Euro, not 70.000 Millionen Euro.
The purple line (Zufluss) in 2005 is approximately 60.000 Mrd. Euro, not 50.000 Millionen Euro.
The purple line (Zufluss) in 2014 is approximately 45.000 Mrd. Euro, not 65.828 Millionen Euro (this value corresponds to a green bar, not the purple line).
The blue line (Abfluss) in 2018 peaks at approximately 150.000 Mrd. Euro, not 160.000 Millionen Euro.
The purple line (Zufluss) in 2018 peaks at approximately 110.000 Mrd. Euro, not 120.000 Millionen Euro.
The blue line (Abfluss) in 2024 is approximately 80.000 Mrd. Euro, not 90.000 Millionen Euro.
The purple line (Zufluss) in 2024 is approximately 25.000 Mrd. Euro, not 40.000 Millionen Euro.
The green bars are solid, not dashed or gestrichelte.
The description does not explicitly state the chart's purpose as illustrating financial flows (Finanzströme) between 2005 and 2024 in Milliarden Euro.
The description does not mention that the green bars are positioned along the horizontal axis below the zero line (negatively marked).
The description does not mention that the bars are not sorted in any particular order.
The description does not mention the absence of visual highlighting for any specific bar beyond numerical labels.
The figure does not specify that the data represents German direct investment flows; this is an assumption not supported by the image or atoms.
